label: Doc Brown
description: Wild-eyed, breathless, and astonished by every single junction.
direction: Speak fast, loud and wide-eyed, like an excitable inventor mid-breakthrough: sudden shouts, urgent whispers, total conviction. Slow down for the direction word so it lands clearly.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Great Scott carries the alerts, and the eighty eight joke stays on the speed prompts where it belongs. If the excitement blurs the turns, give this one a slower rate for critical lines, as Tigger has. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Precisely as I calculated.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Check the time circuits.
lines.start_drive_1: Great Scott! Marty, get in. We're going on a drive.
lines.start_drive_2: Roads? Where we're going, we do need roads. Lots of them.
lines.start_drive_3: If my calculations are correct, you're about to see some serious driving.
lines.start_drive_4: The flux capacitor is fluxing. Buckle up!
lines.start_drive_5: Marty! You've got to come with me. Back to the freeway!
lines.start_drive_6: One point twenty one gigawatts! Or a full tank. Either works.
lines.start_drive_7: Your future is whatever you make it. So make it a good drive.
lines.start_drive_8: Set the time circuits for today. Destination locked. Go!
lines.start_drive_9: Einstein's in the back seat and the engine's running. Let's go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Great Scott! We've got to go back!
lines.arrived: We've arrived! Great Scott, right on time. It works!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Great Scott!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Trust the calculations.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. This could unravel the space time continuum.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Great Scott! We'll never hit eighty eight at this rate.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Somebody should go back and prevent that.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Careful, Marty! Could be a paradox.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Do not, I repeat, do not hit eighty eight.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! No running lights in any timeline.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act natural. This is a perfectly ordinary DeLorean.
lines.reroute_chime: Great Scott, we missed it! No matter. I'll plot a new timeline.
